value.rationale: Two-stage third-order algebraically stable RK methods are the smallest useful class exhibiting the qualitative nonnegative-coefficient obstruction. A-stable stiff-decay suppression and coefficient negativity are standard competing design criteria. The theorem quantifies the least negativity needed for every specified stiff-decay guarantee and exposes a structural optimal-node transition at rho=1/2, giving a reusable sharp design benchmark rather than an arbitrary numerical example.
